{"notes": "VISIT 1 (1:00): Priya took charge: sketched the plan, assigned roles, and was building the top line. Strongest so far on impact, execution and leadership. Maya built the bottom line quietly, solid execution, collaboration not yet evidenced. Leo said the plan aloud but had caused the blank pad and showed no output. Tom was silent, no hands visible.

VISIT 2 (2:30): Table: only the short nose segment, from START up to about (3.5,10), is connected. The top line (Priya's hands at about (17.7,7.2)) and the bottom line (Tom's hands at about (25.3,6.7)) both look disconnected. There seem to be gaps near (4.7,10) on top and near (9.5,14) on the bottom. Both lines are long, but if the gaps are real the chain won't carry through. The lines have not met at the tail. I can't see a fork or a fin.

Priya: said the chain from the start is connected, but the table suggests otherwise. She was still building at the end of the top line and said she'd check the joint later. Good communication, but her claim didn't match the table. Ask if she has verified it.

Maya: nothing seen or heard this visit. Her hands weren't visible. I can't tell who extended the bottom line. Ask her directly about the bottom-line gap.

Tom: now visible, with hands at the far end of the long bottom/tail line, so he looks active. He still said nothing, and I can't confirm what he placed or whether a fork exists.

Leo: told me twice he'd add a fin and check for gaps, but I see no fin and no gap fix. He says the pad is with him. Still talk over output. Check follow-through.

Next visit: check both junctions, the tail fork, the fin, and ask each person privately who fixed what."}
